messages:
maria_g: Kicking off a compact plan for pilot private deployments (Acme + Beta). Need to agree network-mode defaults, upgrade lanes, and must-have launch gates. Can we get quick alignment here?

alex_w: Proposal: three supported modes - `operator` (in-tenant operator shim), `relay` (egress-relay through our relay service), `peering` (VPC/peering/BGP). Each has different rollback semantics and preflight checklist. Which mode do we consider GA-first?

sam_ops: Field asks: preserve egress IPs during upgrades is top. NetOps wants a 14-day rollback window and explicit fail-open paths. Peering lane is the trickiest for rollback.

devon_pm: Suggested launch criteria: canary on 2 pilot customers for 2 weeks; automated scripted rollback under 15m; console visible per-tenant egress mapping + upgrade status; runbook + field playbook published. Anything missing?

taylor_eng: Implementation notes: add installer flag `--network-mode={operator,relay,peering}` and validate `--kms` at install. Need installer unit + e2e tests for IP-preserve migration. Example: `installer install --network-mode=operator --kms=aws-kms://alias/redwood`. Also need migration telemetry for prefix/caching state.

jen_security: Need HSM-compatible KMS in the offline/airgap installer before we call GA for regulated customers. Also require audit-log hooks for key ops. I'll create a compliance gating checklist (SOC2 + regulatory customers).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: priv-staging image v0.5.3 deployed (build #3421). Smoke tests passing.

alex_w: Risk: peering IPAM collisions. We should publish an IP mapping schema and ACL handshake template for customer netops to sign off. Also: document NAT fallback options for constrained netops customers.

netops: FYI from netops: we need a machine-readable mapping file (CIDR->node mapping), explicit ACL port lists, and a TTL for reserved IPs during upgrades. We'll review draft spec.

sam_ops: Migration question: customers on distro v1 (no operator shim) — support in-place hot upgrade or side-by-side migration? Zero-downtime is expected.

maria_g: Recommend two upgrade paths: hot-path (operator shim in-place) preserving prefix/KV cache; cold-path (create new nodes + config snapshot, flip traffic during maintenance window). Prioritize hot-path for PLG/pilot customers, cold-path for large regulated customers.

devon_pm: Pilot-ready checklist request: 1) netops interface spec 2) installer flag + smoke tests 3) runbook + rollback steps 4) console telemetry for egress mapping 5) compliance gating. Target timeline: ~6 weeks if no blockers.

taylor_eng: Engineering ETA: shim + installer flag + basic telemetry = ~6w. Migration helper + peering automation = +3w. Need netops sign-off earlier. Also plan a perf bench to ensure <10% p99 latency overhead.

jen_security: I'll own the compliance gating doc. Need time to validate HSM/KMS in airgap flows. That will affect Private GA for regulated customers.

alex_w: Action: I'll draft the netops spec and ACL/IP mapping schema. Will post first pass by EOD Friday and ping netops for review.

sam_ops: I'll produce the runbook + rollback playbook with concrete commands for traffic flip and smoke checks.

maria_g: Final actions: Alex: netops spec by EOD Fri. Taylor: spike on `--network-mode` and tests (2wk spike). Sam: runbook + rollback. Jen: compliance gating draft. Devon: schedule canary onboarding with pilot customers. Reconvene Tue next week with artifacts. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: calendar-bot: sync scheduled Tue 10:00 to review artifacts.

maria_g: Thanks all. Keep updates short in-thread. If blockers surface, call them out and tag `@netops`.
